article.headline: Kussow scores 20 to lead No. 17 Minnesota women past Kansas 76-58
article.description: — Natalie Kussow scored 20 points and No. 17 Minnesota turned back Kansas 76-58 on Wednesday night.
article.linkText: Kussow scores 20 to lead No. 17 Minnesota women past Kansas 76-58
article.story: MINNEAPOLIS, Minn. -- — Natalie Kussow scored 20 points and No. 17 Minnesota turned back Kansas 76-58 on Wednesday night. A 9-0 run turned a one-point deficit into a 20-12 lead late in the first quarter and the Golden Gophers (5-0) led the rest of the way, although the Jayhawks were within 56-49 two minutes into the fourth quarter. Tori Oehrlein added 13 points, Mara Braun had 12 points with eight rebounds and Grace Grocholski had 11 with eight rebounds for Minnesota. S'Mya Nichols had 17 for the Jayhawks (3-2) on just 3-of-16 shooting but 11 of 11 from the foul line. Jaliya Davis added 14 points, all in the second half. It was the second-straight loss to a ranked Big Ten Conference team for Kansas, following a 105-73 loss to Nebraska in South Dakota on Saturday. Braun and Kussow both had 10 points at halftime while Davis, who averages better than 21 points, was scoreless in five minutes because of foul trouble, and the Gophers led 37-28. Nichols had five points in a 9-0 run with her three-point play pulling the Jayhawks within 45-37 midway through the third quarter. Davis made four free throws in the third and twice in the fourth her trips to the line helped Kansas get within single digits. But Kussow had a 3-pointer and a three-point play among her 10 points in the fourth quarter that iced the win. Up next Kansas: vs. South Dakota State in Kansas City on Sunday.
